An '''adamant shovel''' is a [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]] of the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tier, made by smithing a [[diamond shovel]] with [[adamant alloy]]. Sand it digs comes out as glass.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the diamond item carry over; where both have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Digging ===
It breaks shovel blocks at speed {{Value|Adamant Shovel|miningspeed}} and has {{Value|Adamant Shovel|durability}} durability.

=== Intrinsics ===
Efficiency II, Unbreaking II and smelting. The smelting intrinsic makes mined blocks drop their smelted form where the block's loot table supports it: metal ores drop ingots or [[silver bullion]], quartz deposits drop glass, logs drop charcoal, sand drops glass and cobblestone drops [[limestone]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/sand.json}}</ref> Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Adamant Shovel|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Adamant Shovel|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[adamant scrap]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one [[adamant alloy]], returning the alloy but losing the diamonds.

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_shovel.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.03|The vanilla netherite recipes were blocked.}}
{{History line|1.10|A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal item in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. [[Divinity]] was replaced with Efficiency.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Now smelts the blocks it mines. Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
